turbo-combo: Good: 33.2% of games and 28.0% of series, well above the 25% / 16% fair share.
Kinnan is still the combo kill to fear (40 knockouts with infinite mana). Varragoth and Kefka win in combat.
Codie is removed 262 times and countered 0.67 times per game here; the deck keeps winning without it because the prepare creatures cast their reanimation spells uncopied.
storm-spellslinger: Above fair share: 27.7% of games and 19.3% of series.
Niv-Mizzet, Parun wins 73% of its pods and knocks you out in 62%. Save Swan Song and Counterspell for Curiosity effects.
Codie is countered a full 1.0 time per game here, the most of any category.
stax-hatebears: Fair share: 25.3% of games and 17.3% of series.
You lose to creature damage: Myrel, Yasharn and Heliod. Mogis wins half its pods.
Supreme Verdict and Farewell hit about once every other game here. Keep a reanimation spell in hand after a wipe.
control: B's biggest gain over the baseline: 30.1% of games and 23.0% of series (baseline 24.1% / 15.7%).
Control decks wipe you about once a game (Toxic Deluge 202, Blasphemous Act 125). Recursive threats come back where the combo pieces would not.
Alela and Maralen kill in combat; Codie is countered 1.06 times per game.
tokens-go-wide: Weak: 18.7% of games and 8.7% of series, though still above the baseline (14.1% / 6.0%).
Jetmir wins 67% of its pods and knocks you out in 59%. Elesh Norn is your best card here (40% win when cast).
You face only 0.51 wipes per game here; the losses are races, not wipes.
typal: Weak: 16.6% of games and 7.0% of series, knocked out first in 43% of games.
Lathril, Giada and Wilhelt all win in combat before the second reanimation lands.
Atraxa (50% win when cast) is the one threat that turns these games around.
landfall-lands: Weak: 19.2% of games and 11.3% of series.
Karametra wins 55% of its pods and knocks you out in 62%; Tatyova and Yarok also kill in combat.
Archon of Cruelty wins 58% of the games where it lands.
reanimator-graveyard: Middling: 24.6% of games and 15.0% of series, a few points above the baseline.
Living Death from opponents wipes your board 151 times. Their reanimation is now modeled too, which makes this category harder for every Codie build.
Atraxa (63%) and Elesh Norn (56%) are the cards that win here.
aristocrats: Weak: 15.9% of games and 7.3% of series. The baseline did about the same.
Sephiroth and Teysa kill with death-trigger drains; Toxic Deluge hits you 197 times.
Edicts and sacrifice outlets blunt big single threats. This is the matchup where two-at-a-time copies matter most.
voltron: Good: 28.9% of games and 21.7% of series.
Light-Paws wins 90% of its pods. Treat that as a likely simulator outlier and check a sample game before reading much into it.
Atraxa (74%), Elesh Norn (67%) and Archon (67%) all win most games where they land.
artifacts: Your best category: 44.1% of games and 40.7% of series.
Aloy and Urza kill in combat, but you win most races with lifelink and recursive fatties.
Codie is removed 342 times here and you still win; the prepare creatures carry the deck.
enchantress: Fair share: 24.5% of games and 17.7% of series, a little below the baseline.
Alela wins 73% of its pods. You are decked 34 times: the self-mill plus Omit Variables copies can run you out of cards in long games.
Winds of Rath (105) is the wipe to play around.
counters: Good: 32.5% of games and 24.7% of series.
Atraxa (75%) and Elesh Norn (72%) win most games where they land; Elesh shrinks counter decks' boards.
Helga and Atreus kill in combat.
lifegain: Your worst matchup: 5.8% of games and 0 series won (baseline 9.7% / 3.7%).
Amalia Benavides Aguirre wipes the board 347 times in 647 games, more than any card anywhere else. That looks like a simulator outlier worth checking before trusting this category.
Vito and Sorin finish with infinite drain combos; Oloro wins 73% of its pods.
blink-etb: Below fair share: 20.5% of games and 10.0% of series.
Codie is removed 625 times here, the most anywhere. Blink decks keep reusing removal ETBs.
Farewell (170) exiles your graveyard as well as your board; keep a threat in hand.
big-mana-battlecruiser: Above fair share: 27.0% of games and 19.0% of series (baseline 23.2% / 12.7%).
Raggadragga, Ruby and Kona kill in combat. They wipe only 0.25 times per game, so your threats stick.
Atraxa wins 58% of the games where it lands.
aggro-combat: Near fair share: 23.4% of games and 14.7% of series.
Otharri wins 52% of its pods with extra combats.
Elesh Norn wins 71% of the games where it lands: -2/-2 breaks aggro boards.
burn-group-slug: Fair share: 25.2% of games and 16.7% of series.
Sheoldred, the Apocalypse (the opposing commander) wins 89% of its pods. Like Light-Paws, likely a simulator outlier.
Blasphemous Act (170) is the wipe you see most.
